title: Browse the Pollo AI Seedance 2.5 prompt collection, pick a cinematic concept…
content: Browse the Pollo AI Seedance 2.5 prompt collection, pick a cinematic concept category (e.g., short film, music video, vlog), then copy a prompt and run it in Seedance as a starting point when you’re out of ideas.
